study type: secondary analysis of a prospective cohort
exposure: Apgar score at 5 min of life
cohort: 108 infants born to mothers aged 13-46 years between 23 and 36 6/7 weeks of gestation with PPROM
finding: In pregnancies complicated by PPROM, birth weight and Apgar score at 5 minutes of life are accurate predictors of severe neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not found to be a statistically significant predictor of severe neonatal outcomes in pregnancies complicated by PPROM.
